name: Skilled Worker visa
description: A work visa allowing a person to come to or stay in the UK to do an eligible job with an approved employer.
applicant_type: People with a confirmed job offer from a UK employer approved by the Home Office, including applicants applying from outside the UK, extending in-country, updating after a job/employer change, or switching from another UK visa route.
caseworker_type: UK Visas and Immigration (UKVI) work routes caseworking team

application_tracks.track: New application from outside the UK
application_tracks.fee_detail: Standard application fee ranges from £819 to £1,865 depending on circumstances. Lower application fee applies if the job is on the immigration salary list.
additional_requirements: Must prove identity either using the 'UK Immigration: ID Check' app or by attending a visa application centre for fingerprints and photo
Must have a confirmed job offer before applying
Must have a certificate of sponsorship reference number
May need to prove personal savings of at least £1,270 unless exempt or employer support is shown on the certificate of sponsorship
Must pay the healthcare surcharge, usually £1,035 per year

application_tracks.fee_detail: Standard application fee ranges from £819 to £1,865 depending on circumstances. Lower application fee applies if the job is on the immigration salary list.
additional_requirements: Can usually extend a Skilled Worker visa or Tier 2 (General) work visa if the applicant has the same job as when previous permission was granted
Job must be in the same occupation code as when previous permission was granted
Different salary rules may apply for extensions

application_tracks.track: Update visa after changing job or employer
application_tracks.fee_detail: Standard application fee ranges from £819 to £1,865 depending on circumstances. Lower application fee applies if the job is on the immigration salary list.
additional_requirements: Must apply to update Skilled Worker or Tier 2 (General) work visa if changing to a job with a different employer
Must apply to update if the job changes to a different occupation code, unless in a graduate training programme
Different salary rules may apply for updates

application_tracks.track: Switch to Skilled Worker visa from inside the UK
application_tracks.fee_detail: Standard application fee ranges from £819 to £1,865 depending on circumstances. Lower application fee applies if the job is on the immigration salary list.
additional_requirements: Applicant may be able to switch if already in the UK on a different type of visa
Applicant must not travel outside the UK, Ireland, the Channel Islands or the Isle of Man until a decision is made
Different salary rules may apply if switching to become a prison officer

application_tracks.fee_detail: Fee not stated in scraped content for dependants.
additional_requirements: Partner and children must complete separate applications
If successful, dependant visa will usually end on the same date as the main applicant's visa

eligibility_criteria.criterion: Must work for a UK employer approved by the Home Office
eligibility_criteria.details: Applicant must be sponsored by a UK employer that has Home Office approval.

eligibility_criteria.criterion: Must have a certificate of sponsorship
eligibility_criteria.details: Applicant must have a certificate of sponsorship (CoS) from their employer containing information about the role offered in the UK.

eligibility_criteria.criterion: Must have a confirmed job offer before applying
eligibility_criteria.details: The applicant must have a confirmed job offer before making the visa application.

eligibility_criteria.criterion: Job must be on the list of eligible occupations
eligibility_criteria.details: The job must be eligible for the Skilled Worker route and identified by a 4-digit occupation code.
Minimum salary is whichever is higher of £41,700 per year or the going rate for the job.
eligibility_criteria.exemptions: Different salary rules may apply for extensions, updates because of a new job or employer, switching to become a prison officer, some healthcare or education jobs, and applicants with pre-4 April 2024 sponsorship history.
eligibility_criteria.lower_threshold: Salary may be lower in specified circumstances.

eligibility_criteria.criterion: Reduced salary route at 70% to 90% of going rate
eligibility_criteria.details: Applicant can be paid between 70% and 90% of the standard going rate if salary is at least £33,400 per year and one of the listed criteria is met.
eligibility_criteria.exemptions: Not applicable; this is itself an exception route.
eligibility_criteria.lower_threshold: At least £33,400 per year if under 26, studying, a recent graduate, in professional training, has a relevant STEM PhD, or has a postdoctoral position in science or higher education.

eligibility_criteria.criterion: Reduced salary route for non-STEM PhD
eligibility_criteria.details: If the applicant has a relevant PhD level qualification in a subject other than science, technology, engineering or maths, salary must be at least £37,500.
eligibility_criteria.exemptions: Not stated beyond the specific PhD concession

eligibility_criteria.details: For some healthcare or education jobs, salary must be at least £25,000 or more if the job's going rate is higher.
eligibility_criteria.exemptions: Applies only to some healthcare or education jobs
eligibility_criteria.lower_threshold: £25,000 minimum, subject to higher going rate

eligibility_criteria.details: Applicant must be able to speak, read, write and understand English.
eligibility_criteria.exemptions: If English was already proved in a previous successful visa application, the applicant may not have to prove it again.

eligibility_criteria.criterion: Employer must comply with minimum wage and working time rules
eligibility_criteria.details: Employer must ensure the job pays at least the minimum wage and follows UK rules on how many hours a week the applicant works. If not, the application will be refused.
Applicant can usually extend if they have the same job as when previous permission to enter or stay was granted and the job is in the same occupation code.

Lower salary requirements apply if the applicant got their certificate of sponsorship for their first Tier 2 or Skilled Worker visa before 4 April 2024 and has continually held one or more Skilled Worker permissions.
eligibility_criteria.exemptions: Only for applicants meeting both transitional conditions
eligibility_criteria.lower_threshold: Exact lower salary figures not stated in scraped content

eligibility_criteria.details: An applicant switching in the UK must not travel outside the UK, Ireland, the Channel Islands or the Isle of Man until a decision is made.
No visa update is needed for overtime in the sponsored job, and there is no limit on overtime hours. The applicant can work up to 20 hours a week in another job or for their own business.
eligibility_criteria.exemptions: Overtime in sponsored job is unrestricted
eligibility_criteria.lower_threshold: 20 hours a week cap for another job or own business

evidence_requirements.name: Certificate of sponsorship reference number
evidence_requirements.conditional_on: Required for all main Skilled Worker applications
evidence_requirements.verification_method: Check against sponsorship details in Home Office sponsorship systems and application data
evidence_requirements.notes: Employer gives this to the applicant. Applicant can ask employer for a copy of the certificate of sponsorship if they do not have one.

evidence_requirements.name: Proof of knowledge of English
evidence_requirements.conditional_on: Usually required unless already proved in a previous successful visa application or met through an accepted qualification route
evidence_requirements.verification_method: Check qualification or approved test evidence against route requirements
evidence_requirements.notes: Can be proved by UK school qualification, degree from a UK institution, degree from an institution outside the UK taught in English, or passing an English test from an approved provider.

evidence_requirements.name: Valid passport
evidence_requirements.conditional_on: Required unless another identity and nationality document is accepted
evidence_requirements.verification_method: Identity check via 'UK Immigration: ID Check' app or in-person biometric appointment
evidence_requirements.validity_period: Must be valid at time of application
evidence_requirements.notes: Applicant may need to take passport to a visa application centre and can collect it on the day.

evidence_requirements.name: Other document showing identity and nationality
evidence_requirements.conditional_on: Alternative where accepted instead of passport
evidence_requirements.verification_method: Identity check via app or biometric appointment
evidence_requirements.notes: Specific alternative document types not stated in scraped content.

evidence_requirements.name: Job title
evidence_requirements.conditional_on: Required for all main applications
evidence_requirements.verification_method: Cross-check against certificate of sponsorship and application form
evidence_requirements.notes: Submitted as application information rather than necessarily a standalone document.

evidence_requirements.name: Annual salary details
evidence_requirements.conditional_on: Required for all main applications
evidence_requirements.verification_method: Cross-check against certificate of sponsorship and salary thresholds
evidence_requirements.notes: Used to assess whether salary meets £41,700, £33,400, £37,500, £25,000 or going-rate rules as applicable.

evidence_requirements.name: Job occupation code
evidence_requirements.conditional_on: Required for all main applications
evidence_requirements.verification_method: Check 4-digit occupation code against eligible occupation list
evidence_requirements.notes: Applicant may need to ask employer for the occupation code.

evidence_requirements.name: Employer name
evidence_requirements.conditional_on: Required for all main applications
evidence_requirements.verification_method: Cross-check against certificate of sponsorship
evidence_requirements.notes: Will be on the certificate of sponsorship.

evidence_requirements.name: Sponsor licence number
evidence_requirements.conditional_on: Required for all main applications
evidence_requirements.verification_method: Check against sponsor records and certificate of sponsorship
evidence_requirements.notes: Will be on the certificate of sponsorship.

evidence_requirements.name: Bank statements
evidence_requirements.conditional_on: Needed as evidence of enough personal savings to support yourself in the UK unless the certificate of sponsorship shows the employer can support you
evidence_requirements.verification_method: Review statements for available funds
evidence_requirements.notes: Scraped content gives savings amount of at least £1,270 but does not state any 28-day holding rule.

evidence_requirements.name: Proof of relationship with partner
evidence_requirements.conditional_on: Needed if partner is applying with the main applicant
evidence_requirements.verification_method: Review relationship evidence submitted with dependant application
evidence_requirements.notes: Specific document types not stated in scraped content.

evidence_requirements.name: Proof of relationship with children
evidence_requirements.conditional_on: Needed if children are applying with the main applicant
evidence_requirements.verification_method: Review relationship evidence submitted with dependant application
evidence_requirements.notes: Specific document types not stated in scraped content.

evidence_requirements.name: Tuberculosis test results
evidence_requirements.conditional_on: Required if the applicant is from a listed country
evidence_requirements.verification_method: Check TB evidence from approved testing arrangements
evidence_requirements.notes: Scraped content does not specify certificate wording or validity period.

evidence_requirements.name: Criminal record certificate
evidence_requirements.conditional_on: Required if working in a role for which this is required; scraped content is truncated after 'if you’re working in'
evidence_requirements.verification_method: Review certificate from relevant authority
evidence_requirements.notes: Specific occupations requiring this are not visible in scraped content.

evidence_requirements.name: GCSE in English
evidence_requirements.conditional_on: Can be used to prove English if it is a qualification from a UK school begun when the applicant was under 18
evidence_requirements.verification_method: Review qualification evidence
evidence_requirements.notes: Accepted as one of the listed UK school qualifications.

evidence_requirements.name: A Level in English
evidence_requirements.conditional_on: Can be used to prove English if it is a qualification from a UK school begun when the applicant was under 18
evidence_requirements.verification_method: Review qualification evidence
evidence_requirements.notes: Accepted as one of the listed UK school qualifications.

evidence_requirements.name: Scottish National Qualification level 4 or 5 in English
evidence_requirements.conditional_on: Can be used to prove English if it is a qualification from a UK school begun when the applicant was under 18
evidence_requirements.verification_method: Review qualification evidence
evidence_requirements.notes: Accepted as one of the listed UK school qualifications.

evidence_requirements.name: Scottish Higher or Advanced Higher in English
evidence_requirements.conditional_on: Can be used to prove English if it is a qualification from a UK school begun when the applicant was under 18
evidence_requirements.verification_method: Review qualification evidence
evidence_requirements.notes: Accepted as one of the listed UK school qualifications.

evidence_requirements.name: Degree-level qualification awarded by a UK institution and taught in English
evidence_requirements.conditional_on: Can be used to prove English
evidence_requirements.verification_method: Review degree evidence
evidence_requirements.notes: Must be both taught in English and awarded by a UK institution.

evidence_requirements.name: Degree from an institution outside the UK taught in English
evidence_requirements.conditional_on: Can be used to prove English
evidence_requirements.verification_method: Review degree evidence
evidence_requirements.notes: Scraped content confirms this route but does not show any further validation requirements.

evidence_requirements.name: English test from an approved provider
evidence_requirements.conditional_on: Can be used to prove English if applicant does not rely on qualification routes or previous proof
evidence_requirements.verification_method: Check approved provider test evidence
evidence_requirements.notes: Specific test names are not stated in scraped content.

evidence_requirements.name: Fingerprints and photo (biometric information)
evidence_requirements.conditional_on: Required if applicant is instructed to attend a visa application centre instead of using the app
evidence_requirements.verification_method: Captured at visa application centre
evidence_requirements.notes: Part of identity verification.

workflow_stages.description: Applicant confirms sponsor approval, certificate of sponsorship, eligible occupation code, salary level and English language route.
decision_points: Whether the employer is Home Office approved
Whether the job is eligible
Whether salary meets standard or reduced threshold
Whether healthcare/education salary rules apply
Whether transitional pre-4 April 2024 rules may apply
caseworker_actions: Assess sponsor and role details
Check occupation code and salary basis
Identify whether standard, reduced, healthcare/education or transitional salary rules apply

workflow_stages.description: Applicant collects mandatory and conditional evidence including sponsorship, identity, English and financial evidence.
decision_points: Whether savings evidence is needed
Whether TB test results are needed
Whether criminal record certificate is needed
Whether dependant relationship evidence is needed
caseworker_actions: Review whether all mandatory fields and documents are present
Identify missing conditional evidence

workflow_stages.description: Applicant applies online and can save the form and complete it later.
decision_points: Whether correct application track has been selected
Whether fee and healthcare surcharge are payable
caseworker_actions: Receive application data
Check declared job, salary, sponsor and occupation details

workflow_stages.description: Applicant proves identity either through the 'UK Immigration: ID Check' app or by attending a visa application centre.
decision_points: Whether app-based identity verification is available
Whether biometric appointment is required
caseworker_actions: Confirm identity route used
Review passport or other identity document
Confirm biometrics captured where required

workflow_stages.description: Caseworker assesses eligibility, salary, English, sponsorship and any conditional evidence.
decision_points: Grant
Refusal due to ineligibility
Refusal due to insufficient evidence
Potential refusal where employer does not meet minimum wage or working time rules
caseworker_actions: Check salary against £41,700, £33,400, £37,500, £25,000 and going-rate rules as applicable
Check whether immigration salary list fee reduction applies
Check English evidence route
Check sponsor licence number and certificate of sponsorship details
Check savings evidence where employer support is not shown

workflow_stages.description: Applicant is informed whether the application is granted or refused.
decision_points: Grant main applicant visa
Grant dependant visa
Refuse application
Treat application as withdrawn in travel-related switching scenarios if applicable from wider rules, though not expressly stated in scraped content
caseworker_actions: Record outcome
Issue decision communication
Align dependant end date with main applicant where applicable

workflow_stages.description: After grant, applicant may need to extend, update after job changes, or observe limits on additional work.
decision_points: Whether extension is needed
Whether update application is needed for new employer or occupation code change
Whether additional work is within permitted conditions
caseworker_actions: Assess whether same job and same occupation code are retained for extension
Assess whether a new application is required after employer or occupation code change
Note that overtime in sponsored job is unrestricted and separate work is capped at 20 hours a week

possible_outcomes: Granted dependant visa with end date usually matching the main applicant's visa
Refused - employer not approved by the Home Office
Refused - no valid certificate of sponsorship
Refused - job not on eligible occupation list
Refused - employer does not meet minimum wage or working time rules
Refused - English language requirement not met
Withdrawn or jeopardised application due to prohibited travel while switching, exact outcome wording not stated in scraped content

communication_touchpoints.content_summary: Online system allows applicant to start, save and complete the Skilled Worker visa form later.

communication_touchpoints.trigger: Identity verification route determined during application
communication_touchpoints.content_summary: Applicant is told whether to use the 'UK Immigration: ID Check' app or attend a visa application centre for fingerprints and photo.

communication_touchpoints.trigger: Need for certificate of sponsorship copy
communication_touchpoints.content_summary: Applicant may ask employer for a copy of the certificate of sponsorship if they do not have one.
Applicant is informed whether the Skilled Worker or dependant application is granted or refused.

risk_indicators.indicator: Salary below the applicable threshold of £41,700, £33,400, £37,500, £25,000 or the relevant going rate
risk_indicators.caseworker_action: Check which salary regime applies and refuse if the salary does not meet the correct threshold.

risk_indicators.indicator: Occupation code does not match an eligible occupation
risk_indicators.caseworker_action: Verify the 4-digit occupation code and refuse if the role is not eligible.

risk_indicators.indicator: Employer is not approved by the Home Office or sponsor licence details do not match
risk_indicators.caseworker_action: Check sponsor licence number and sponsorship records before deciding.

risk_indicators.indicator: Certificate of sponsorship missing or inconsistent with application details
risk_indicators.caseworker_action: Cross-check CoS reference, employer name, salary, job title and occupation code.

risk_indicators.indicator: Employer appears not to meet minimum wage or working time rules
risk_indicators.caseworker_action: Refuse application if the employer does not comply.

risk_indicators.indicator: Applicant claims reduced salary concession without evidence of age, study status, recent graduate status, professional training, relevant PhD or postdoctoral role
risk_indicators.caseworker_action: Request or review evidence supporting the concession and assess against the correct threshold.

risk_indicators.indicator: Applicant relies on healthcare or education salary rules but role may not fall within the relevant jobs
risk_indicators.caseworker_action: Confirm the role is one of the healthcare or education jobs covered by national pay scales.

risk_indicators.indicator: Savings evidence absent where employer support is not shown on the certificate of sponsorship
risk_indicators.caseworker_action: Check for bank statements or sponsor maintenance confirmation.

risk_indicators.indicator: TB test results missing for applicant from a listed country
risk_indicators.caseworker_action: Check whether the nationality/residence pattern triggers the TB requirement and whether valid results were provided.

risk_indicators.indicator: Criminal record certificate missing for a role that requires it
risk_indicators.caseworker_action: Confirm whether the occupation triggers the requirement and assess submitted certificate.

risk_indicators.indicator: Applicant switching in-country has travelled outside the UK, Ireland, the Channel Islands or the Isle of Man before decision
risk_indicators.caseworker_action: Check whether the application remains valid under route rules; scraped content warns not to travel.

risk_indicators.indicator: Applicant changes employer or occupation code without making an update application
risk_indicators.caseworker_action: Assess whether a fresh update application is required.
